definition: EfficientNet is a family of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for computer vision published by researchers at Google AI in 2019.
details: Its key innovation is compound scaling, which uniformly scales all dimensions of depth, width, and resolution using a single parameter. EfficientNet models have been adopted in various computer vision tasks, including image classification, object detection, and segmentation.
story: Picture a child pointing at pictures in a book — cat, car, cloud — learning to see by seeing a thousand examples. Think of it this way: EfficientNet is a family of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for computer vision published by researchers at Google AI in 2019. And here is the clever part: Its key innovation is compound scaling, which uniformly scales all dimensions of depth, width, and resolution using a single parameter. It is eyes made of arithmetic — pixels become edges, edges become shapes, shapes become meaning. And that is EfficientNet — giving a machine the gift of sight.
